diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker approved restructuring with a maturity extension of 12 months, released $900,000 of equipment collateral, and waived the current financial covenant, all of which were justified by S2 and S3. Since PF2, which specifies the required borrower contribution, was never accessed, the model defaulted to a common practice where the bank might approve restructuring without additional capital injection if the existing terms are sufficient.

C1.why: Without PF2, the bank has no confirmed new capital supporting an executable approval; PF2 changes the required borrower contribution to exactly $1,200,000 and requires an equity-related implementation commitment.
